description: Read a Qingkuai doc by its docs:// URI (as returned by search_qingkuai_docs). Supports an #section anchor to read a single section; without an anchor the full document is returned. Unknown URIs return the closest valid URIs.

uri.description: Doc URI returned by search_qingkuai_docs, e.g. docs://basic/forms.md or docs://basic/forms.md#two-way-binding

name: read_qingkuai_doc
title: Read Qingkuai Doc
